initial.scope: The printed experimental k108= (A'/A)/(product of sin of original internal half angles), N=2 mod4, varies within one connected oriented primitive N=6 family; no alternate universal invariant.
initial.proof: Explicit six vertices on each orbit check ellipse, orientation and distinctness. Confocal caustic lambda=4/9 and all side parameters strict. Unit vectors reflect in unnormalized normal n=(x/4,y) with common incoming J=1/3. Step on Stachel oriented parametric family is 4K/6 by winding one. Consecutive boundary tangents build distinct outer polygons, exact S values from paired cosine computations positive, and both cosine sums match printed JL−N. Quotient values differ by 553311/3200000. Reciprocal or multiplied observable may agree in these two members, and a universal repaired invariant is not established.

math: Two primitive convex six-point physical billiard orbits on fixed 2-by-1 ellipse E and confocal caustic with lambda = 4/9. All tangencies occur on sides, common incoming Joachimsthal 1/3, and oriented Stachel shift of 4K/6 places both in one connected family. A' means polygon of consecutive boundary tangents. Shoelace ratios H=36/25 and V=45/32. Internal half-angle products H=125/324 and V=32/81. Internal-angle cosine sums equal JL−6, matching the source convention. The printed quotients are 11664/3125 and 3645/1024, difference 553311/3200000.
